name: Coordinateur du départ
description: Long-limbed middle-aged adult, slate skin with gold mottling, high flat forehead crest, long angular mandibles, very long dreads tightly gathered into a low tail. Sleeveless sand robe over trousers, long scarf tucked into utility harness, one bronze arm guard. Holds an unmarked hinged bronze inventory slate close to body and lifts one hand in a small calm directional gesture; narrow pack with paired water flasks. Alert relaxed stance.
